finding: NBRC 1221 and 1474 name only the supplied 1 M HEPES-KOH stock. The candidates instead assert HEPES buffer moiety, total and Potassium-containing buffer species as material has-part constituents using RECIPE_TRANSCRIPTION. These labels describe inferred chemical/speciation classes, not material inputs transcribed from the sources. The 1 M nominal stock strength does not establish the stated constituent basis, potassium stoichiometry or free KOH input.
proposed_bounded_fix: Keep the useful named nominal whole-stock description and conditional family owner handles. Remove unsupported component/speciation assertions and represent composition as unknown with source-name evidence and explicit limits, if permitted by native schema; do not infer solvent, free KOH or neutralization ratio. Preserve full original component objects in this immutable finding and original history.
